result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred limits: CGL at $1M per occurrence/$2M aggregate, E&O at $2M, cyber/privacy at $5M when relevant data is handled, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, it unnecessarily adds an across-the-board one-year post-termination coverage obligation and an express at-own-expense requirement, neither required by the playbook. The cyber trigger is also broader and less precise than processing Customer Data because it includes mere access to any Confidential Information. Further, maintaining all policies for one year is not a well-tailored solution for claims-made coverage; an extended reporting period provision would be more precise. These additions materially exceed the requested position despite the clause otherwise meeting the required limits.
